raw.details:
HACK CULT ’26 - National-Level Hackathon

Presented By: Blithchron ’27, IIT Gandhinagar | Hosting Partner: NxtWave

Ideas Are Everywhere. What Matters Is What You Build With Them.

Hack Cult ’26 is a national-level hackathon presented by Blithchron ’27, IIT Gandhinagar, with NxtWave as its Hosting Partner. It brings together innovators, problem-solvers, and aspiring builders to develop creative, technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges.

Designed to encourage innovation and practical problem-solving, Hack Cult ’26 offers participants the opportunity to explore challenges across multiple domains, develop their ideas, and showcase their solutions on a national platform.

Problem Domains:

1. Banking & Finance:

  • Develop innovative solutions in digital payments, financial literacy, fintech, and related areas.

2. Manufacturing & Industry:

  • Explore solutions for supply-chain optimisation, process automation, and improved operational efficiency.

3. Technology & Software:

  • Build innovative platforms, developer tools, scalable software, and technology-driven solutions.

4. Culture, Media & Entertainment:

  • Create digital experiences, interactive media tools, and solutions that modernise art, content, and entertainment.

Hackathon Format:

Hack Cult ’26 follows a hybrid format with two phases:

Phase 1: Online Hackathon Round

  • Dates: 23–25 October 2026

Participants will work on their solutions during the online round. Based on the evaluation, shortlisted teams will advance to the offline grand finale.

Phase 2: Offline Grand Finale

  • Date: 14 November 2026
  • Venue: IIT Gandhinagar, Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Shortlisted teams will present their solutions at the IIT Gandhinagar campus and compete in the grand finale.

Eligibility & Team Size:

  • Eligibility: Open to everyone.
  • Team Size: Individual participation is permitted, or participants can form teams of up to 4 members.
  • Registration Fee: Free.

Prizes:

A total prize pool of ₹30,000 is up for grabs. Further details regarding prize distribution will be announced soon.

Important Dates:

  • Registration Deadline: 22 October 2026, 11:59 PM
  • Online Hackathon Round: 23–25 October 2026
  • Offline Grand Finale: 14 November 2026

Rules & Evaluation:

Detailed submission guidelines, judging criteria, and participation rules will be announced soon. Participants are advised to follow official updates for further information.

Ready To Build?

Have an idea that can solve a real-world problem? Bring your creativity, turn your ideas into solutions, and take on the challenge at Hack Cult ’26, presented by Blithchron ’27, IIT Gandhinagar, with NxtWave as the Hosting Partner.

Register Now And Be Part Of The Innovation!
